spans.s:
n. (-नं)
Praising, eulogising: see प्रशंसन.
E.
प्र before शंश to praise, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Praising, eulogising.
E.
प्र before शंस to praise, ल्युट् aff.; also प्रशंशन.

f. (-शा)
Praise, eulogium.
E.
प्र before शंश to praise, अङ् and टाप् affs.: see प्रशंसा.

f. (-सा)
Praise, applause, flattery, commendation.
E.
प्र especially, शंस to praise, affs. अङ् and टाप्; the root is also read शंश, when this word and the analogous derivatives are read प्रशंशा, &c.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be praised, praise-worthy.
E.
प्र before शंस to praise, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Praised, eulogised.
E.
प्रशंसा, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be praised, praise-worthy.
E.
प्र before शंस to praise, तव्य aff.

m. (-त्वा)
The ocean.
f. (-री)
A river.
E.
प्र before शद् to go, and क्वनिप् Uṇādi aff., र inserted before ङीप्.

m. (-त्वा)
1 Virtue, piety.
2 BRAHMĀ.
f. (-री)
Acquisition, accomplishment.
E.
प्र before षद to go, क्वरप् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Killing, slaughter.
2 Pacifying, tranquillising.
3 Quiescence, reposing.
E.
प्र before शम to pacify, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Allayed, appeased, relieved, tranquillised, &c.
E.
प्र before शम to be calm, causal v., aff. क्त.

ind.
Having appeased.
E.
प्र before शम to be calm, causal v., ल्युप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Pacified, quieted, appeased, flattered.
E.
प्र before शम to be at rest, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Happy, well, right.
2 Good, excellent, best.
E.
प्र before शंस to praise or commend, aff. क्त.

f. (-स्तिः)
1 Excellence, eminence.
2 Eulogy.
E.
प्र before शंस to praise, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A small branch or twig.
E.
प्र before शाखा a branch, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Calmed, calm, tranquillised.
2 Ceased, discontinued, (as active effort.)
3

Ended.
4

Relieved.
E.
प्र before शम to be calm, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Resting.
E.
प्रशान्त, and चेष्टा effort.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Peaceful, calm, composed.
E.
प्रशान्त, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Weakened, prostrate in strength.
E.
प्रशान्त, and ओजस् strength.

f. (-न्तिः)
Calm, quiet, tranquillity, moral or physical.
E.
प्र before शम to be calm, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (प्रशान्)
Quiet, tranquil.
E.
प्र before शम to be tranquil, क्विप् aff., and the penultimate long.

m. (-मः)
1 Tranquility, quiescence.
2 Allaying, pacifying.
3 Laying, suppressing.
E.
प्र before शम to be at rest, अच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Governing, ruling.
2 Enacting.
E.
प्र before शास to rule, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Governed, ruled.
2 Promulgated, enacted.
E.
प्र before शास to rule, क्त aff.

m. (-ता)
A ruler or governor.
E.
प्र before शास to govern, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्)
Sprinkling, scattering.
E.
प्र before श्च्युत to sprinkle, शतृ aff.

m. (-श्नः)
A question, a demand, an inquiry.
f. (-श्नी)
An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, aff. नङ्.

f. (-ती)
A riddle, an enigma, an intricate or enigmatical question.
E.
प्रश्न a question, and टूती playing.

m. (-थः)
Laxity, relaxation, flaccidity.
E.
प्र before श्रथ to be loose, aff. घञ्.

m. (-यः)
1 Affection, affectionate regard or solicitation.
2

Respect.
3

Courtesy, civility.
E.
प्र before श्री to serve, aff. अच्.

n. (-णं)
1 A fountain, a cascade, a water-fall.
2 Oozing, flowing.
3 A range of mountains in the south, part of the western Ghats.
E.
प्र before श्रु to ooze or drop, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
1 A pool of water formed by dripping of springs in the mountains.
2 Dripping or fall of water, cascade, cataract.
3 Washing away of rocks, &c. by the dripping of water.
4 Oozing, leaking, dripping.
m. (-णः)
1 Sweat, perspiration.
2 Pissing, urining.
3 A range of mountains in the peninsula; also Malayavān.
E.
प्र before स्रु to drop, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रश्रबण.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Modest, humble, well-behaved.
E.
प्र before श्रि to serve, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Flowing, oozing, issuing.
E.
प्र before श्रि to drop, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Languid, flaccid, loose, relaxed, unnerved.
E.
प्र before श्लथ to be loose, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be asked.
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
Asking, demanding, an asker or questioner.
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 A leader, a conductor, one who goes first or before.
2 Prior, preceding.
3 Chief, principal, best.
f. (-ष्ठी)
The wife of a leader or chief.
E.
प्र pre-eminent, स्था to stay or be, aff. क.

m. (-वाट्-वाड्)
A young bull or steer, training for the plough, &c.
E.
प्रष्ठ a leader, and वह to bear, aff. ण्डि or विच.

f. (-ही)
A cow pregnant with her first calf.
E.
प्रष्ठ here said to be the first birth, and वह to bear, aff. ण्वि or विच, fem. aff. ङीप्, and व is changed to ऊ, which with the preceding vowel becomes औ by special rule.

r. 1st cl. (प्रसते)
1 To spread or diffuse.
2 To bring forth young.

m. (-सः)
A bearded dart.
E.
प्र before अस to throw, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Eternal, constant, continual.
2 Opened, expanded.
3 Obtained, gained, attained.
4 Attached to, devoted to, (person or thing,) engaged in.
5 United to, connected with, accompanying.
6 Applied to, used, employed.
n. adv. (-क्तं)
Continually, incessantly, eternally.
E.
प्र before षञ्ज to unite or embrace, aff. क्त.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Union, connexion.
2 Adherence or attachment to.
3 Energy, perseverance.
4

Acquiring.
5

Inference, conclusion, deduction.
6 A topic, or subject of conversation.
E.
प्र before षञ्ज to unite, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Introduction, insertion.
2 Association, connexion.
3 Addiction or attachment to.
4 Connected language or style.
5 Connected reasoning or argument.
6 Double or conjoint result, producing two effects, attaining two objects by one act.
7 Revealing a secret.
8 (In dramatic language,) A second or subsidiary incident or plot.
E.
प्र preceding, षञ्ज to join, aff. अच्.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A yoke for cattle.
E.
प्र and आङ before सञ्ज to join, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Bringing into use, employing, applying, bringing to bear.
2 Combining, connecting.
E.
प्र before षञ्ज to unite, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Purity, cleanness, brightness, transparency.
2 Favour, graciousness, complacency.
E.
प्र before सद to go, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Clear, clean, bright, pellucid.
2 Pleased, delighted.
3 Complacent, gracious, favourable.
f. (-न्ना)
1 Propitiating, pleasing.
2 Spirituous or vinous liquor.
E.
प्र principally, &c. सद to go, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
1 Feeding, causing to taste or eat.
2 Tasting.
E.
प्र before अश to eat, intransitive or causal v., ल्युट् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Brightness, pellucidness, clearness, purity.
2 Favour, kindness, being pleased with.
E.
प्रसन्न clear, and तल aff.; also with त्व, प्रसन्नत्व.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Agreeable looking, smiling, looking pleased.
E.
प्रसन्न, and मुख face.

f. (-रा)
Spirituous liquor.
E.
प्रसन्न clear, and ईरा wine.

n. (-भं)
Violence.
adv.
1 Violently, forcibly.
2 Much, exceedingly.
E.
प्र gone, passed, सभा an assembly.

n. (-णं)
Considering, deliberating, discussing.
E.
प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-क्षा)
Deliberation, judgment.
E.
प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
To be weighed, considered, discussed, &c.
ind.
Having considered.
E.
प्र and सम् before ईक्ष to see, यत् or ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Who or what proceeds, projects, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 Spreading, extending.
2 Space, room.
3 Occasion, opportunity.
4 Affectionate solicitation.
5 Speed, velocity.
6 Battle, war.
7 Multitude, assemblage.
8 An iron arrow.
9 A projection, a process.
E.
प्र before सृ to go, aff. अप् or घ.

m. (-रः)
1 Going about, spreading, extending.
2 Going to forage, spreading over the country for grass and fuel.
E.
प्र afar, सृ to go, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Going forth or round.
2 Surrounding an enemy.
3 Spreading over the country to forage.
E.
प्र before सृ to go, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रसरणी and प्रसरणि.

n. (-णं)
1 Going about, spreading.
2 Expanding, extending.
3

Unfolding.
4

Surrounding an enemy.
5 The dispersion of an army by detachments for that purpose, or for collecting forage.
f. (-णी)
A plant, (Pœderia foetida.)
E.
प्र before सृ to go, aff. ल्युट्; also प्रसरण.

f. (-णिः or णी)
Surrounding an enemy.
E.
प्र before सृ to go, aff. अनि, and ङीप् optionally added.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
1 Expanding, spreading, bursting.
2 Proceeding, projecting.
E.
प्र before सृ to go, शतृ aff.

m. (-कः)
An uninvited guest, an intruder.
E.
प्र before सृप to go, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Spreading, stretching, expanding.
2 Going, proceeding.
E.
प्र before सृप to go, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्)
Advancing, proceeding.
E.
प्र before सृप to go, शतृ aff.

m. (-वः)
1 Bringing forth, bearing, (as young.)
2 Birth, production.
3 Offspring, posterity.
4

Fruit.
5

A blossom, a flower.
E.
प्र before सू to bear, aff. अप्.

m. (-कः)
A tree, commonly Piyāl, (Buchanania latifolia).
E.
प्रसव a flower, aff. कन्.

mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्)
Bearing.
f. (-न्ती)
A woman in labour.
E.
प्र before सू to bear, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
The footstalk of a leaf or flower, the petiole or peduncle.
E.
प्रसव a flower, and बन्धन a binding.

f. (-ली)
A mother.
E.
प्रसव, and श्यल place, ङीप् aff.

m. (-ता)
A father.
f. (-त्री)
A mother.
E.
प्र before सू to bear or have offspring, aff. तृच्.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Having or bearing young.
E.
प्रसव, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Contrary, reverse, inverted, reverted.
E.
प्र inclined towards, सव्य the left or wrong side.

m. (-हः)
A beast or bird of prey.
E.
प्र before सह to be able, aff. अच्.

m. (-नः)
A beast or bird of prey.
n. (-नं)
1 Embracing, an embrace.
2

Defeat.
3

Bearing, enduring.
E.
प्र before सह to bear, aff. ल्युट्.

ind.
1 Forcibly, violently.
2 Exceedingly.
E.
प्र excessively, सह to be able, यप् aff.

m. (-रः)
A robber, a plunderer.
E.
प्रसह्य violently, and चौर a thief.

m. (-दः)
1 Clearness, cleanness, brightness.
2 Favour, kindness, propitiousness, approbation.
3 Well being, welfare.
4 Composure, calmness of mind.
5 Poetry written in an elegant but an easy style.
6

Perspicuity.
7

Connexion, association.
8 Food that has been offered to an idol, or of which a spiritual teacher has partaken.
E.
प्र before सद to go, aff. घञ्.

m. (-दः)
A temple, a palace, a building consecrated to a deity, or inhabited by a prince.
E.
प्र before सद to go, aff. घञ, and the vowel of the prefix lengthened, or आङ् prefixed to the verb.

n. (-नं)
1 Boiled rice.
2 Cleaning, freeing from soil or impurities.
3 Pleasing, gratifying.
f. (-ना)
1

Service.
2

Worship.
E.
प्र before सद to go, aff. ल्युट्, fem. aff. टाप्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Pleasing, propitiating.
E.
प्र before सद to go, aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Kind, propitious.
2 Happy.
E.
प्रसाद, and स्थ who or what is.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pleased, propitiated.
2

Worshipped.
3

Purified, cleansed.
E.
प्र before षद to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Who or what accomplishes or perfects.
2 Who or what cleanses or purifies.
f. (-का)
1 Wild rice.
2 A dresser, a female attendant, one who decorates or adorns.
E.
प्र before साध to accomplish, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Dress, decoration, embellishment.
2 Accomplishing, effecting.
nf. (-नं-नी)
A comb.
f. (-नी)
A drug, commonly Siddhi.
E.
प्र before साध to accomplish, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ornamented, decorated.
2 Accomplished, completed, done.
E.
प्र before साध to finish, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
1 Accomplishable, what may be done.
2 To be done for, destroyed, defeated.
E.
प्र, and साध to accomplish, यत् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Stretched, expanded, extended.
2 Laid out.
E.
प्र before सृ to go, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Going along gently, gliding, flowing, creeping.
2 Spreading, expanding.
3 Spreading around, or about.
4 Expanded, unfolded.
E.
प्र before सृ to go, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Diligent, attentive, adhering to, or engaged in.
2 Ingrossed by, devoted or attached to.
3 Bound, fastened.
n. (-तं)
Pus, matter.
E.
प्र before षिञ् to bind, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Eaten, devoured.
2 Tasted, taken into the mouth without reaching to the throat.
n. (-तं)
Oblation to deified progenitors.
E.
प्र before अशित eaten.

f. (-तिः)
1 Ligament, fetters, binding, tye.
E.
प्र before षिञ् to bind, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Famous, celebrated.
2 Adorned, ornamented.
E.
प्र before सिद्ध accomplished.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 Fame, celebrity, notoriety.
2 Ornament, decoration.
3 That which is notorious or known.
E.
प्र before षिध to go, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Sleeping, asleep, fast asleep.
E.
प्र, and सुप्त slept.

f. (-सूः)
1 A mother.
2 A mare.
3 A spreading creeper.
4 The plantain.
E.
प्र before सू to bear, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-का)
A mare.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Born, engendered.
2 Bearing, bringing forth, delivered.
n. (-तं)
A flower.
f. (-ता)
A woman who has borne a child, or one who is recently delivered.
E.
प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्त, fem. aff. टाप्; also प्रसूतिका.

f. (-तिः)
1 Bringing forth, (as young.)
2 Birth, production.
3 Offspring, children, a son or daughter.
E.
प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-का)
A woman who has had a child, or one who has been recently delivered.
E.
प्रसूता the same, pleonastic aff. कन्, fem. form.

n. (-जं)
Pain, affliction, mental or corporeal.
E.
प्रसूति birth, and ज produced; attending man from birth.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Born, produced.
n. (-नं)
1 A flower, a bud, a blossom.
2 Fruit.
E.
प्र before षू to bear, aff. क्त, form irr.

m. (-षुः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
प्रसून a flower, and इषु an arrow.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dispersed, extended, spread abroad.
2

Stretched.
3

Long, lengthened.
4 Modest, humble.
5 Swift, quick.
6

Gone.
7

Attached to, engaged in, occupied.
8 Appointed.
m. (-तः)
The palm of the hand, hollowed as if to hold liquids.
f. (-ता)
The leg.
n. (-तं)
A measure of two Palas.
E.
प्र before सृ to go, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
The palm of the hand hollowed.
E.
प्र before सृ to go, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-कः)
1 Sprinkling, wetting.
2 Dropping, oozing.
3 Running or watering of the mouth and nose.
E.
प्र before सिच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.

f. (-का)
A small garden.
E.
प्र excellence, सद to go, aff. ण्वुल्, fem. aff. टाप्.

mfn. (-वान्-टुषी-वस्)
Pleased, propitiated, favourable.
E.
प्र before षद to go, क्वसु aff.

m. (-वः)
1 Part of a lute: see the next.
2 A sack.
E.
प्र before षिव to tie or sew, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A part of a lute, a wooden vessel covered with leather, placed under the neck to render the sound deeper.
2 A crooked piece of wood at the end of a lute.
E.
प्र before षेव to serve, aff. क्वुन्.

n. (-नं)
Purging, diarrhœa.
E.
प्र before स्कन्द to go, aff. ल्युट्.

f. (-का)
Diarrhœa.
E.
प्र before खन्द to go, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Fallen, dropped.
m. (-न्नः)
A sinner, an outcast, one who has violated the usages of his caste or order.
E.
प्र before स्कन्द to go, to drop, aff. क्त, form irr.

m. (-रः)
1 A stone or rock.
2 A jewel, a precious stone.
3 A couch, made of flowers or grass.
4 Any bed or couch.
5 A tabular form of representing the long and short vowels of poetical metre.
6 Notation of music.
7 A handful or bundle of Kuśa grass used at sacrifices.
E.
प्र before स्तृ to spread, aff. अप्.

m. (-रः)
1 A jungle, a thicket or wood, overgrown with grass.
2 A bed made with blossoms, leaves, &c.
3 Any bed or couch.
E.
प्र before स्तृ to spread, aff. घञ्.

m. (-वः)
1 Opportunity, occasion, season.
2 Occasional or introductory eulogium.
3 Subject matter of a composition.
4 A chapter, a section.
E.
प्र before स्तु to praise, aff. घञ्.

f. (-ना)
1 Commencement, introduction.
2 A dramatic prelude, an introductory dialogue, usually spoken by the manager and one of the actors.
E.
प्र before स्तु to praise, aff. ल्युट्; the commencement of books, &c. being usually the praise of gods or princes.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Suited to the occasion, appropriate, seasonable.
E.
प्रस्ताव, and सदृश like.

m. (-रः)
A bed or couch made of blossoms, flowers, leaves, &c.
E.
प्र before स्तॄ to spread, aff. अच्, and इर substituted for अर.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
